text:
maya: hey team — dropped three prototypes for the new user entry surface. trying to consolidate the small-cta rail + hero banner into one compact surface for small screens. PTAL and drop a quick +1 / nit.

liam: saw them, thanks. quick impressions: variant A feels busy, variant C is very sparse. prefer something between.

sophia: accessibility first ask — keyboard order in A is wrong: CTA, then image, then heading. should be heading -> description -> CTA. also contrast on the secondary text is low (#6c6c6c on white).

maya: noted. Liam — can you sketch a middle-ground that keeps the sample-project cards but shrinks padding? current cards are 24px which eats vertical space. try 12–16px.

liam: yep, will do. also thinking about microcopy: current primary CTA "Create API Key" might be intimidating for brand-new users. suggestions? "Get started" or "Try a sample project"?

sophia: +1 for "Try a sample project" when the CTA launches a curated demo. if it goes to key creation page, "Create your first key" is clearer. we should A/B based on intent.

devon: from a metrics POV, we want to nudge sample projects first. onboarding completion correlates with opening a sample project more than immediately creating a key.

maya: ok we'll default CTA to "Try a sample project" and show a secondary under it: "Create API key" with softer styling.

samir: small nit — the banner animation currently reduces motion but still fades over 600ms. reduce to 200ms or provide a motion-free toggle in preferences. 600ms triggers vestibular sensitivity reports in research.

liam: agreed on motion toggle. also raising an HTML semantics concern: the cards are divs with role="button". change to <button> or <a> where appropriate for screen readers.

sophia: keyboard focus ring: it's using a dotted outline that disappears on dark mode. switch to an accessible 3px solid focus ring using the brand blue on both themes.

maya: thanks. logging action items: 1) liam to produce compact padding variant + semantic HTML update. 2) sophia to write the a11y checklist and swap focus styles. 3) devon to surface metric goal for sample project CTA. 4) samir to spec motion-reduce toggle. i'll update the Figma and link.

console-bot: Uploaded prototype: https://redwood.in/figma/entry-prototypes — versions: compact-v2, hero-mid, sparse-c.

liam: quick question — do we let the sample project cards pin a preferred stack? thinking of a small toggle: "Pin this sample to dashboard". might add complexity for new users.

devon: avoid pin on first-run. we can save that for the 2nd session. first-run = low friction.

sophia: one more a11y test scenario: NVDA reading order with image alt text set to empty string when decorative. include a test note in the checklist.

maya: tiny copy tweak for the onboarding checklist: change "Complete setup" to "Finish setup (takes ~2 mins)" — small time estimate increases completion.

samir: perf aside — the initial load for compact-v2 adds an extra network request for images. consider inlining low-res placeholders and lazy-loading the rest.

liam: I'll iterate on compact-v2 with the padding + focus fixes and push by EOD. expecting handoff to dev next week.

maya: perfect. thanks all — I'll post the updated Figma and add the checklist to the PR description. :raised_hands:
